basic_info.headline: Platform & Infrastructure · Compliance-Aware Systems at Scale
basic_info.about: Staff software engineer with deep experience in regulated environments, spanning test automation, platform engineering, and compliance-aware system design. Known for building durable infrastructure, reducing institutional friction, and helping teams reason clearly about risk, cost, and long-term architecture.

experience.title: Staff Software Engineer
experience.description: Provided technical leadership across team and platform boundaries in a regulated, multi-cloud genomics environment. Continued to evolve and support core SDLC and compliance tooling while improving team-level architecture and infrastructure. Retired end-of-life systems, unified cost and usage insights across platforms, and designed event-driven systems to process and manage large volumes of patient data in a compliant, cost-efficient manner. Built engineering culture through mentorship, thoughtful code review, and a team reading group, and coached teams toward proactive planning that balances near-term priorities with long-term architectural vision.

experience.title: Software Engineer IV
experience.description: Core contributor to a company-wide SDLC and SOP revision that significantly reduced manual compliance overhead. Designed and implemented an organization-level automated regulatory validation and documentation capture system to support the new SDLC, and led its rollout and adoption across the company’s CI/CD platforms. Worked closely with engineers and management to deliver a frictionless, reliable system spanning both APIs and user-facing tooling.

experience.title: Software Test Engineer III
experience.description: Expanded and maintained the organization’s automated test data creation platform and built additional tooling to support fluent, maintainable automated tests. Served as primary test partner for a major redesign of the internal genomics analysis pipeline, supporting a transition to a modern GATK-based architecture. Built and maintained CI/CD infrastructure for the team, ensuring continuous delivery of compliant, reliable software, and participated in early organizational efforts to adopt a microservices-based approach.

experience.title: Owner and Principal Consultant
experience.description:
Prologue Quality Analysis provides invaluable QA support to smaller software studios who recognize the value of testing and quality infrastructure. It is widely accepted that quality considerations are far less costly when introduced early into a project, but many smaller organizations rightly determine that it is unfeasible to hire a dedicated quality assurance professional until much later. This gap often proves quite detrimental to fledgling businesses, who discover too late that they have accrued significant technical debt.

Prologue fills this gap by providing on-demand access to experienced quality assurance professionals who can provide immediate testing, deploy mature tools such as test automation frameworks and continuous integration servers, and provide coaching for practices such as unit testing, test-driven development. We make quality easier, so you can focus on getting your software off the ground.

experience.title: Software Quality Specialist
experience.description:
Worked as an integral part of a digital print engineering team to build software to drive thousands of daily print orders through the factory floor to shipping. Tracked and resolved software issues that were reported by CSRs and floor workers. Established, configured, maintained and tracked a continuous integration server. Built automated deployment scripts. Built an automated web browser tool for testing, mass order submission, and site status tracking. Introduced engineering team to unit testing and test-driven development, and trained them to capably use both techniques. Refactored legacy code for maintainability, testability and loose coupling. Wrote post-hoc unit tests for major sections of legacy code. Performed manual tests when needed.

Made use of C#, Nunit, MSTest, Moq, Selenium, SVN, GitHub, Jenkins, SQL and WireShark.

experience.title: Software Test Technician
experience.description:
Worked with engineering team to test a software platform created to drive digital planetarium hardware. Helped develop team-wide processes that lent themselves to a culture of quality. Built and maintained lightweight test documentation, including test plans, processes and test cases, while keeping the goal of balancing our quality needs with limited resources in mind. Tracked and reported defects. Verified defect fixes. Developed several testing tools to meet the needs of a small, streamlined team. Supervised release testing efforts across the engineering team, maintained and ran a suite of semi-automated regression scripts, and tracked performance metrics between versions. Coordinated localization efforts.

	Made use of C#, Bugzilla, Testopia, SVN, XML, and a proprietary in-house scripting language to test an enterprise-level application using a mixed methodology.

experience.title: Software Quality Assurance Analyst, contract-to-hire
experience.description:
Developed test plans for elements of a complex, database-driven medical web application, and then produced the cases called for by the plans. Ran test cases as assigned, determining results based on expected outcomes and personal judgment.  Tracked and reported defects. Verified defect fixes. Served as acting lead over a project that spanned across four organizations within two corporations. Led two local testers and integrated the testing efforts of all four organizations in order to complete the project by deadline and well-tested.

	Made use of Rally, SQL, PICT, C#, WireShark, and a variety of in-house tools to test an IE-compatible web application using an Agile methodology.
